what: per new item, the accepted forms of the gold that a scene-aware audit marks as not naming the gold in the scene's sense or as fitting another option of its list, each with the reason: candidates for the builder's FORM_DROPS_V3, read by hand

prompts.SYSTEM: You audit the accepted names of a benchmark answer. You get a short scene that implies one thing without naming it, the thing (the gold answer, in the scene's language), and a numbered list of names under which a reader's answer would be accepted. Mark a name WRONG when, read on its own, it would also be said of something that is NOT the gold as this scene means it: another sense of an ambiguous word (a bank that is a bench, a chimney that is a fireplace, "offbeat" meaning eccentric instead of out of time), an ordinary word or phrase for a different thing or activity, a broader or narrower thing, or a name that leaves out or changes a part of a compound gold (its qualifier, material or place), or a name that would equally be said of one of the OTHER OPTIONS listed with it (a generic name that covers the gold and a sibling, or the usual translation of another option). A faithful translation, synonym, spelling variant or rewording of the WHOLE gold in the scene's sense is RIGHT. Answer with one verdict per name, in order, and a few words of reason for each WRONG.
